name: Yani & Derek
source:
Yani receives a confession from her classmate, Derek, and accidentally accepts it. Can she clear up this mistake or end up liking him as well?

[From [url=https://shalie-xy.itch.io/yani-and-derek]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
同班同學德里克向雅妮表白，她一不小心答應了。她能把這場誤會解釋清楚，還是到頭來也會喜歡上他？
